integrity.claim_consistency: The same all-positive-index valuation classification is stated in every scientific file.
integrity.proof: Non-Archimedean dilogarithm functional equation and coefficient bounds; finite computation corroborates only.

scientific_limitations: The exact cubic formula is restricted to indices divisible by four, with the two other parity classes classified separately.
Does not address the companion plus-one or adjacent-index Delannoy conjectures.
No absolute publication-priority or independent mathematical certification is claimed.
title: Resolution of the sharp binary valuation conjecture for central Delannoy numbers
